items.title: Preview: LA Tech at South Alabama
items.summary: RUSTON -- Louisiana Tech will look to extend its four-game winning streak and remain unbeaten in Sun Belt Conference play when the Bulldogs travel to Mobile, Alabama, to face South Alabama on Saturday at Hancock Whitney Stadium.

items.title: Finley Tabbed With Pair Of Career Honors Following Career Performance vs. Old Dominion
items.summary: RUSTON – Following a dominant performance on the field against Old Dominion, Eli Finley was named the Week 8 John Mackey Award Player of the Week and an Earl Campbell Tyler Rose Award Player of the Week Honorable Mention.

items.title: Bulldogs Dominate Homecoming, Shut Out Monarchs In Ruston
items.summary: Louisiana Tech continued its dominant defensive stretch Saturday afternoon, shutting out Old Dominion, 26-0, in front of 20,444 fans at Joe Aillet Stadium to secure its fourth consecutive victory and remain unbeaten in Sun Belt Conference play.

items.title: Preview: LA Tech vs. Old Dominion
items.summary: RUSTON -- Louisiana Tech returns to Origin Bank Field at Joe Aillet Stadium Saturday afternoon as the Bulldogs welcome Old Dominion for Homecoming and look to extend their three-game winning streak while remaining unbeaten in Sun Belt Conference play. Kickoff is scheduled for 4 p.m. CT, with the contest airing on ESPN+.

items.title: Know Before You Go | Old Dominion Gameday Guide
items.summary: RUSTON | There's no place like home, and Louisiana Tech is ready to welcome the Bulldog Family back to Ruston for Homecoming 2026.

items.title: Six Chapters, One Story. Chapter Four: Welcome Home
items.summary: RUSTON  | Welcome Home. No matter where the road takes us, it always leads home.

items.title: Bulldogs Blank Warhawks In First Meeting Since 2000
items.summary: MONROE, La. -- Louisiana Tech used a dominant defensive performance and three second-half touchdowns to shut out in-state rival ULM, 24-0, Saturday night at FMOL Health | St. Francis Stadium, extending its winning streak to three games while remaining unbeaten in Sun Belt Conference play.

items.title: Preview: LA Tech at ULM
items.summary: RUSTON – Coming off a big win over one rival, Louisiana Tech hits the road for Monroe on Saturday for the first edition of the Radiance Technologies I-20 Showdown, taking on the ULM Warhawks for the first time since the 2000 season on Saturday, October 17. Kickoff is set for 7 p.m. CT on ESPN+ at FMOL Health | St. Francis Stadium.

items.title: Baker Tabbed With Trio Of Weekly Accolades Following Career Performance Against UL-Lafayette
items.summary: RUSTON – It was a busy day promoting Blake Baker on Monday afternoon, as he received three separate honors for his high-level performance in Saturday's win over in-state rival UL-Lafayette. The Cypress, Texas native was named the Sun Belt Offensive Player of the Week, as well as being listed to the Davey O'Brien Great 8 and the Manning Award Stars of the Week List for Week 6.

items.title: Bulldogs Mount Fourth-Quarter Comeback, Down Ragin’ Cajuns In Sun Belt Opener
items.summary: RUSTON -- Louisiana Tech erased a 12-point fourth-quarter deficit and scored the go-ahead touchdown with 46 seconds remaining to defeat in-state rival UL-Lafayette, 32-31, Saturday night at Origin Bank Field at Joe Aillet Stadium, securing the Bulldogs' first-ever Sun Belt Conference football victory in program history.
